By integrating sustainable technologies, upgrading critical infrastructure and enhancing the experience for performers, staff and audiences, the Theatre has not only modernized its operations but reaffirmed its commitment to innovation, accessibility and environmental stewardship. This project demonstrates how historic venues can successfully evolve to meet contemporary needs without compromising their architectural heritage or artistic mission. Through thoughtful planning and strategic investment, PPAC now operates with greater energy efficiency, technical reliability and digital readiness. These improvements will generate lasting economic, environmental and community benefits while lowering operating costs, reducing environmental impact and improving access to world-class performing arts experiences. Looking ahead, these upgrades position PPAC to serve as a model for other historic theaters seeking to modernize responsibly and sustainably. With this project complete, PPAC is better equipped than ever to fulfill its mission: to serve the entertainment needs of Rhode Island, connect the community to educational opportunities, preserve the historic integrity of the building and maintain fiscal responsibility while engaging and enriching the lives of all who enter its doors.
